heading: Designation of officers with particular expertise in military justice or healthcare

tree.heading: Secretary Designation.—
tree.text: The Secretary may designate a limited number of officers of the Coast Guard as having particular expertise in—

tree.heading: Promotion and Grade.—
tree.text: An individual designated under this section—

children.text: shall not be included on the active duty promotion list;
shall be promoted under section 2126; and
may not be promoted to a grade higher than captain.
